aiResearchSummary.text: Corveus Medical is engaged in developing systems and methods for treating or preventing heart failure by interrupting nerve activity, as described in 'Systems and methods for interrupting nerve activity to treat a medical ...'. The approach involves devices such as vascular catheters with telescopic needle assemblies designed to coordinate nerve activity interruption for one or more target nerves. Their research and development focus on innovative device-based interventions for heart failure.
